title: PostgreSQL (CloudNativePG)
description: Health, activity, storage, query timing and logs of every CloudNativePG cluster.

panels.title: Oldest backup
panels.description: Daily backups; CNPGBackupTooOld fires after 26 hours.

panels.title: Busiest connections
panels.description: Highest share of max_connections in use.

panels.title: Highest XID age
panels.description: Transaction ID age; vacuum keeps it low. Writes stop near 2 billion.

panels.title: Clusters
panels.description: One row per CloudNativePG cluster. Query mean needs components/cnpg-query-insight on the cluster.

targets.expr: max by (cluster) (label_replace(sum by (pod) (cnpg_backends_total{pod=~"($cluster)-[0-9]+"}) / max by (pod) (cnpg_pg_settings_setting{pod=~"($cluster)-[0-9]+", name="max_connections"}), "cluster", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[0-9]+"))

max by (cluster) (label_replace(sum by (pod) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{pod=~"($cluster)-[0-9]+"}[1h])) / (sum by (pod) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{pod=~"($cluster)-[0-9]+"}[1h])) + sum by (pod) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_read{pod=~"($cluster)-[0-9]+"}[1h])) > 0), "cluster", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[0-9]+"))

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of block reads served from shared buffers. Below about 95% the database reads disk often.

targets.expr: max by (cluster) (label_replace(sum by (pod) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{pod=~"($cluster)-[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (pod) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{pod=~"($cluster)-[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (pod) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_read{pod=~"($cluster)-[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0), "cluster", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[0-9]+"))

panels.title: Longest open transaction
panels.description: CNPGIdleInTransaction fires at 30 minutes idle in a transaction.

panels.title: Deadlocks, conflicts and temp files
panels.description: Empty is good. Temp files mean a sort or hash spilled past work_mem.

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: Application databases; the volumes are 20 to 30 GiB.

panels.title: WAL written
panels.description: Every WAL byte is archived to Garage.

panels.title: Checkpoints per hour
panels.description: Requested checkpoints mean WAL filled max_wal_size before checkpoint_timeout.

panels.title: Mean statement time
panels.description: Total execution time over executions, per database. CNPGQueryLatencyHigh fires at 3x its 7-day median.

panels.title: Time spent in statements
panels.description: Seconds of execution per second; 1.0 is one backend busy all the time.

panels.title: Time waiting on IO
panels.description: Block read and write time from track_io_timing.

panels.title: Top statements in the time range
panels.description: Each cluster's top 20 statements by total time. Find the text with: SELECT query FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE queryid = <queryid>; its slow runs also appear below with the same query_id.

panels.title: Mean time of top statements
panels.description: One line per statement. A line that rises means that statement got slower.

panels.title: Slow statements (over 500 ms)
panels.description: From log_min_duration_statement, slowest first. Statements over 2 s also log their plan through auto_explain. Messages include literal parameter values.

targets.expr: container:postgres pod:~"^(${cluster:regex})-[0-9]+$" "duration:" | unpack_json | extract "duration: <duration_ms> ms" from record.message | filter duration_ms:>0 | format "<duration_ms> ms  <pod>/<record.database_name>  <record.user_name>  query_id <record.query_id>  <record.message>" as _msg | fields _time, _msg, pod, record.database_name, record.query_id, duration_ms

container:postgres pod:~"^(${cluster:regex})-[0-9]+$" | unpack_json | filter record.error_severity:in(WARNING, ERROR, FATAL, PANIC) | format "<record.error_severity>  <pod>/<record.database_name>  <record.user_name>  <record.message>  <record.query>" as _msg | fields _time, _msg, pod, record.error_severity, record.database_name
